---
name: "Acceptance Criteria"
description: "Use when drafting, scoping, reviewing, or creating Azure DevOps work items or GitHub issues. Requires acceptance criteria to be written as a bulleted list."
---

# Acceptance Criteria Format

Write acceptance criteria as a bulleted list.

- Each bullet must state one observable, testable outcome.
- Use clear completion conditions rather than implementation tasks.
- Include relevant functional, non-functional, security, error-handling, and integration outcomes.
- Do not use paragraphs, numbered lists, or tables for acceptance criteria.
